$comment: Everything the Marketplace RUNTIME role (marketplace_app) may do on AkadVerse's database — and therefore everything it can do.
Single source of truth for: scripts/provision-db-roles.mjs (generates the GRANTs), src/lib/db-target.ts (refuses to start if the role
holds anything beyond this), and tests/db/runtime-role.test.ts. Each entry was derived from the Prisma calls in services/ and src/
(including nested writes and upserts). Adding a privilege here is a reviewed change: it widens what the app can touch.
Tables not listed (Task, Schedule, Suggestion, EmailConnection, Skill*, Review, Category, student_playlists, PendingSignup,
_prisma_migrations, ...) get no privilege at all. No TRUNCATE, REFERENCES or TRIGGER anywhere. No sequences are needed: every id
is generated by Prisma (uuid/cuid). Ownership of every object stays with AkadVerse's owner role, so ALTER/DROP are impossible.

User.why: Sign-in (password hash verified, never copied), session re-check, names/emails on orders, admin user management, deliverer student-email OTP. No INSERT/DELETE (accounts are created in AkadVerse) and no UPDATE of password/email/role.

BusinessVerificationRequest.why: Seller verification requests and admin decisions.

BusinessReport.why: Buyer reports a business; admin resolves.

Product.why: Product listings: create, edit, stock reservation, delete.

CheckoutPayment.why: One row per Paystack checkout reference.

OrderItem.why: Order lines (created with the order), fulfilment and payout state.

Delivery_x_businesses.why: Pickup per business, deliverer payout state.

MarketplaceInstance.why: Database identity marker (read-only to the app).

DeliveryRosterSettings.why: Default max deliveries per slot occurrence, per delivery operation (upserted).

CentralDeliverySlot.why: Time slots of the central Marketplace delivery operation (admin-managed; deactivated, never deleted).

RosterSlotDay.why: Recurring per-weekday delivery limit of a slot (upserted; removed when reset to the default).

RosterAssignment.why: Recurring weekly deliverer assignments (added/removed by an admin).

RosterException.why: Date-specific roster overrides (set and restored by an admin).

ScheduledDelivery.why: Per-order slot occurrence and planned deliverer (history kept, never deleted).

DeliveryHandoverCode.why: Student handover code per vendor booking (hash + server-encrypted copy + masked view); attempts and verification.

DeliveryCodeSubmission.why: Audit/idempotency record of each delivery-code submission; admin review of late ones.

SlotBriefingNotice.why: Pre-slot briefing sent-record (deleted only when a send failed, so the next run retries it).

DeliveryShiftCheckIn.why: Admin check-in that starts a deliverer's shift (gates their pickups/deliveries; append-only).
